obs: "The reason is, that as the liability is one created by statute, the special remedy provided by the same statute is exclusive."
Fourth Nat. Bank of NY v. Francklyn
"A general liability created by statute, without a remedy, may be enforced by an appropriate common law action."

"the question whether the remedy in the federal courts should be by action at law or by suit in equity depends upon the nature of the remedy given by the statutes of the State."
